svg.title: Three layers: UI, Core, Adapter, then the iPhone
svg.desc: The UI talks HTTP to the Core on 127.0.0.1. The Core asks the Adapter to set, route or clear. In the app only the Adapter, device.py, talks to pymobiledevice3, which reaches the phone over USB through the RemoteXPC tunnel. On the phone the location simulation feeds CoreLocation, so every app sees it.
